page_title: AUX 1-2 LEN | Auxerre v Lens 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' 1 - 2 Gooal! Adrien Thomasson takes over corner duties. Abdallah Sima (Lens) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 1:2.
90+6' Lens force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+5' Chance! Samson Baidoo (Lens) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the right side of the goal, but Donovan Leon is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
90+3' Christophe Pelissier is stunned as referee Francois Letexier shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+2' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Malang Sarr (Lens) for a tough tackle.
90+2' Abdallah Sima (Lens) sees his header crash off the right post after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
90+2' The referee awards a corner and Adrien Thomasson (Lens) goes over to take it.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
88' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
87' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
85' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) is penalised for a foul. Francois Letexier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lamine Sy (Auxerre) is coming onto the pitch as Francisco Sierralta cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Looks like Francisco Sierralta (Auxerre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
81' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Florian Thauvin and he is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Lens).
81' It's time for a substitution. Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) comes on in place of Wesley Said.
80' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
77' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
77' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Francois Letexier blows for a foul.
76' The substitution is prepared. Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Elisha Owusu.
74' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post!
74' Rayan Fofana (Lens) trips an opposition player and Francois Letexier signals a foul. Auxerre are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
73' Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
72' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
72' The resulting corner from Clement Akpa (Auxerre) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
69' That's the end of the game for Lassine Sinayoko, who is replaced by Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre).
68' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) has received a yellow card for his foul.
66' A yellow card for a tackle by Florian Thauvin (Lens). Francois Letexier doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
65' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) was probably a bit loose with his words to Francois Letexier, who decides to show him a yellow.
62' Robin Risser (Lens) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
62' Francois Letexier rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Danny Namaso (Auxerre).
61' 1 - 1 Francisco Sierralta (Auxerre) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 1:1.

61' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) latches on to a perfectly taken corner kick deep into the box and attempts to head home. His bullet header heads straight towards the roof of the net, but it's deflected onto the crossbar by the goalkeeper. A wonderful effort.
60' Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
60' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
60' The foul by Josue Casimir (Auxerre) was seen by Francois Letexier who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
58' The ratio of the ball possession is 55:45.
54' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
54' Rayan Fofana (Lens) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
53' Wesley Said (Lens) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Francois Letexier blows for a foul.
50' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
47' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
46' Yellow card! It's like Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Francois Letexier agrees and books him.
46' Referee Francois Letexier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle as Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
43' Rayan Fofana (Lens) commits a foul and Francois Letexier immediately signals a free kick.
41' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) is being substituted because of an injury. Pierre Sage sends Rayan Fofana on the pitch.
40' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
40' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
38' Wow, what an escape. Wesley Said (Lens) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
36' Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.

34' What a great touch by Danny Namaso (Auxerre)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
33' Francois Letexier blows his whistle. Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) commits a foul after dangerous play.
29' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Risser comes off his line to gather the ball.
26' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) touches the ball with his hand.
24' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Wesley Said (Lens) heads on.
23' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) commits a rough challenge and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
18' Dangerous play by Matthieu Udol (Lens). Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Francisco Sierralta (Auxerre) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.
16' Francois Letexier shows the yellow card to Samson Baidoo (Lens) for a heavy challenge.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Adrien Thomasson slips it to Odsonne Edouard (Lens) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom right corner with a great effort. The score is 0:1.
11' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.

11' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Donovan Leon, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
10' Good chance for Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the right post.
8' A spell of possession for Lens in an attempt to control the game.
5' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lens will kick-off.
Francois Letexier will officiate today.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
